items.title: These 7 private and public banking stocks have an upside of up to 20% in one year, according to analyst
items.description: When FPI money returns, there are two parts of the market that tend to draw it first: Financial services broadly, and banks within it. So the very thing that worked against these stocks when the FPIs were selling has started to work for them now that the foreigners are buying. Monday saw the first clear sign of it.

items.title: Stocks in news: Cochin Shipyard, Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Coal India, BHEL and Bajaj Finance
items.description: Indian markets are set to resume trading after the Diwali holiday, with investors tracking key stocks such as Cochin Shipyard, Kalyan Jewellers, MRF, Coal India, BHEL and Bajaj Finance amid Q2 earnings and corporate developments. Nifty faces immediate resistance at 25,150–25,200.

items.title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
items.description: The Nifty index showcased mixed movements on Monday, opening on a high note before being swayed by profit booking. Experts predict a period of consolidation ahead for Indian stocks amid ongoing inflation apprehensions. Global market signals are expected to play a major role in shaping market trends, especially with promising earnings forecasts and lower crude oil costs.

items.title: Time to shed fear and think positive? 5 mid-cap stocks from different sectors with upside potential of up to 33%
items.description: Mid-cap stocks tend to move more than large-caps. And that works both ways. They rise faster when the market is rising, and fall harder when it is falling. Keep that in mind as the market’s mood changes for the better because oil prices are dropping and the macro worries responsible for the long sell-off are starting to go away.

items.title: Stock Radar: BSE stock up over 10% in a month, technical charts hint at a bottom?
items.description: BSE Ltd has recently broken out from an inverse head and shoulder pattern, indicating potential upward movement. The stock has previously experienced a correction but found support around Rs 3,000 levels. Experts predict a target above Rs 4,000 in the coming months if the stock sustains above crucial support levels. The daily MACD indicates bullish momentum, while the RSI shows it may still have room for growth.

items.title: Manyavar maker Vedant Fashions struggles to revive growth as same-store sales drop 5.8% in Q2
items.description: Manyavar maker Vedant Fashions is facing mounting competition and slowing growth, with same-store sales declining 5.8% in the September quarter. Revenue grew at an annual rate of just 2.7% between 2022-23 and 2025-26. Industry experts say demand moderation and aggressive store expansion have added to the company's challenges.

items.title: NCLT flags undervalued, fraudulent HDIL property sale in 2019
items.description: The order relates to a commercial office premises in Dheeraj Pali Arcade Building on Pali Road, Bandra West, which was transferred to the buyer through a registered sale agreement dated July 4, 2019. The transaction involved former HDIL directors Rakesh Kumar Wadhawan and Sarang Rakesh Wadhawan.

items.title: Blackstone to invest Rs 5,000 crore in IIFL Finance for 16% stake as company raises Rs 6,414 crore
items.description: IIFL Finance will raise Rs 6,414 crore through a capital infusion led by Blackstone, which will invest Rs 5,000 crore for an approximately 16% stake. Co-promoters Nirmal Jain and R Venkataraman will contribute Rs 1,264 crore through warrants, while Anchorage Capital will invest Rs 150 crore.
